description: A test script using Playwright to perform smoke testing of the 'default-values' project, specifically testing the loading and navigation of a list of people.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Initializes the browser and page before tests run, and loads the index.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs a test that navigates to the 'People' list and verifies the presence of the 'New Person' link.

methods.name: afterAll
methods.description: Closes the browser after tests complete.

ctags.name: browser
ctags.pattern: /^  let browser: Browser = undefined as any$/

ctags.name: page
ctags.pattern: /^  let page: Page = undefined as any$/

fields.name: let browser: Browser = undefined as any
let page: Page = undefined as any
